notes.title: Update 1.28.1 in now live on all platforms
notes.notes:
The Common eland has arrived in Tikamoon Plains – a true giant among antelopes and a worthy challenge for any hunter. Strong, resilient, and majestic, the eland will put your tracking and shooting skills to the test. This update also brings a range of gameplay improvements and refinements. Aiming now feels smoother thanks to reduced blur on iron sights, and the zeroing for the Prairie Hunter the Jack iron sight has been adjusted to 50 meters for more accurate shots. We’ve also refreshed the audio experience with updated sound effects for the Steyr-Gams rifle and several rifles from the Hunter’s Advantage Pack.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/f50963085dcfc7ee887346524884fa2d2d506117.jpg"]

Update 1.28.1 also brings important fixes inspired by your reports. The electronic caller delay has been resolved, its UI now updates correctly, and the hunter sense dot alignment on the Prairie Hunter the Jack has been corrected. We’ve also smoothed out some localization issues and minor environmental glitches, like the levitating grass on Nez Perce Valley. For more details, please check the patch notes below.


Design the Future Reticle with Integrix


Alongside this patch, we’re excited to share something special. We’re teaming up with Integrix Optics to design a brand-new custom reticle, and we want your help. Whether you’re a hunter in the field or in-game, this is your chance to shape how it looks and works.


The survey is short and simple and your submissions will help us and Integrix Optics shape the final design of the new scope. We’re excited to see how the community’s vision comes together! Take the survey via THIS LINK.

notes.title: Integrix Joins the Hunt – Free Scope in Update 1.27.1!

Update 1.27.1 is now live, bringing a free Integrix® iX6 scope, improved headlamp visibility, and visual fixes for a smoother, more immersive hunt.

Known for their commitment to precision, clarity, and craftsmanship, this proud optics brand is now officially a part of the in-game gear lineup, with their iX6 3-18x44 scope available free for all players. Designed for mid-to-long range shooting and low-light conditions, this premium scope delivers next-level accuracy for those who demand precision in every shot.

Additionally, based on player feedback, we've adjusted the reticule thickness on the Overgaard Night Stalker 5–15x and Overgaard Night Stalker 3-9x scopes for better usability and visual clarity.

notes.title: Update 1.27: Night Hunting Pack DLC is out now!
notes.notes:
Update 1.27 is now available on all platforms and introduces a brand-new night vision scope, a complete overhaul of the HUD customization options, and the paid Night Hunting Pack DLC, featuring four advanced optics designed for low-light conditions, adding quality and versatility to your nighttime hunting expeditions.

When the Sun Sets, the Hunt Begins — Night Hunting Pack DLC is Available Now!

The Night Hunting Pack DLC includes a powerful set of digital optics designed to support stealth, visibility, and long-range accuracy during the darkest hunting conditions. The pack is part of Update 1.27 and is sold separately from the base game at an SRP of €4.99 / $4.99. The base game is required to play the DLC. Way of the Hunter is available for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S at an SRP of $39.99 / €39.99. 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760210/Way_of_the_Hunter__Night_Hunting_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288320/Way_of_the_Hunter/"][/dynamiclink]
Watch the new trailer here:[previewyoutube="bNtK0knD9dU;full"][/previewyoutube]

What’s in the Night Hunting Pack DLC

Overgaard Night Hawk 4-16x Binoculars Designed for serious hunters who demand reliable gear, these high-quality night vision binoculars feature a 4–16x magnification range. With crisp black-and-white night vision, they help you identify movement and terrain detail even in challenging light conditions.


Overgaard Night Stalker 5-15x Rifle Scope An adaptable digital riflescope tailored for medium to long-range use. Built for precision in pitch-black environments, it delivers a clear visual with variable magnification. Its high-resolution sensor gives you the advantage when lining up shots during late-night hunts.


ZOOMXD Blackout-NV Collimator A close-range digital collimator built for instinctive aiming and situational awareness in low-light scenarios. While compact and fast to deploy, it offers fixed magnification and a clean digital overlay. Ideal for close-quarters hunts where reaction time is critical.


ZOOMXD ShadowView 1-5x Crossbow Scope Crafted for crossbow hunters, this scope excels in low-light conditions - from deep woods to the twilight edge. With a 25mm objective lens for precise targeting, it’s built to keep you accurate when visibility is at its worst.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/1b29a990d3d13391f8ed39bb511556293a847260.jpg"]
Free for All Players: Update 1.27 Now Live!
Update 1.27 is now available for all players, even if you don’t own the Night Hunting Pack DLC.



Overgaard Night Stalker 3-9x Rifle Scope 

This free night vision scope is available to all players via in-game money from the in-game store. Lightweight, versatile, and perfect for entry-level night hunts.



Reworked HUD Customization 

You asked, we delivered! The HUD system now features four global presets and complete control over individual elements:

Fully Visible: Everything is always on screen.

Dynamic: HUD elements appear during interactions and fade out after 4 seconds (with an exception to Tutorials and Mission Information HUD elements).

Immersive: No HUD at all for complete immersion.

Custom: Fine-tune each HUD element separately to your liking.

When you start adjusting individual elements, your global preset will automatically switch to "Custom" so you can create your perfect setup. Note: This update resets your HUD elements to default (Fully Visible). If you set the Mission Information to your custom preset and turn it OFF, you can still toggle its visibility at any time using the “O” key.

For new players, once you’ve completed the tutorial missions in Nez Perce Valley, you’ll have full access to customize the HUD elements to fit your playstyle.

notes.title: Update 1.26.7 is now live on all platforms
notes.notes:
Update 1.26.7 brings several key improvements to Way of the Hunter. PC players can now enjoy FSR2 and DLSS presets for better visual quality and performance. Multiplayer features a location ping system, join and leave notifications, and an upgraded server browser with map details and difficulty levels. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/9a65f15c1fe4f8eb2e159f6c295432a7a3db3654.jpg

Additionally, we’ve fixed several bugs, including shotgun reload issues, audio glitches, and floating trees in Transylvania - for more details, please check the patch notes below.

Enhanced Hunting Map UI 
With this update, we're introducing an enhanced Hunting Map UI, providing clearer insights into animal herds, their habitats, and the impact of your hunting activities. This update makes herd management more accessible by allowing players to track herd fitness over time and see how their hunting choices affect populations. Previously, manual note-taking was required, but now, after each in-game year, you can easily view herd fitness levels on the map, helping to refine your strategy for more effective and sustainable management. For detailed info on this feature, we’ve prepared a full breakdown HERE.

notes.title: Community Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Hunters!

First, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in our end-of-year survey featured in the latest Hunter Log. Your enthusiasm and passion for Way of the Hunter have inspired us.

We received a great turnout, with thousands of responses pouring in! Initially, when we planned to close the survey, we noticed many of you still hadn’t had the chance to participate. So, we extended it and sent out reminders, leading to an even greater turnout. The feedback we’ve gathered so far is highly valuable to our team.

Here’s a sneak peek at some early survey insights we’d like to share with you:

Survey Sneak Peek

Top Countries
Our global community continues to grow! Here’s where most of our survey participants are hunting from:

 United States: 48.2%

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/27a767862a4a5a40992391fcd1d02edd5dbd1021.png

As we continue to dive into your responses, we realize just how much there is to consider. The significant amount of feedback highlights how engaged and invested our community is, which motivates us even more to carefully evaluate every suggestion and priority.

While we originally hoped to share more details by tomorrow, we need a bit more time to fully prepare and evaluate your feedback. Thank you for being part of this journey. Your input is shaping the future of Way of the Hunter, and we’re committed to delivering experiences that also reflect a lot of what matters most to you, our core community members.

Thank you for your patience, stay tuned!

Update 1.26.4 is now live! This update brings a new rare-fur animal, unique task for each map, adjustments to firearm energy balance for an improved hunting experience, and additional fixes for Way of the Hunter.

Firearms energy rebalence
Since this was a highly requested change and it affects every firearm in the game, we would like to give you a bit more detail on what the goal of this rebalance is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/e678167bfcdb5fa264ba212617c53fc60d52507f.jpg

Though you can view it as an across-the-board buff, the energy increase varies for each firearm, and it is especially pronounced with long-range shots. Real-life bullets do not lose less energy the longer they travel, but we believe this to be the best solution for the widest variety of in-game hunts. Overall, the firearms should now feel more authentic to their real-life counterparts and they should prove to be more lethal, although you will still need place your shots carefully.
